article.headline: Harry Styles, Sam Fender and Billie Eilish Headline Record Breaking Glastonbury 2027
article.summary: Harry Styles, Sam Fender, and Billie Eilish will headline Glastonbury 2027, with Cher appearing in the Sunday legends slot.
article.body:
Tickets for the 2027 festival vanished in just 42 minutes, marking the fastest sell-out following the event's 2026 fallow year to allow Worthy Farm to recover. Attendees will face the highest ticket prices in the festival's history at £408, including a £5 booking fee per person. For this return to Somerset, organizers have secured the youngest group of headliners seen in the 21st century, with Sam Fender and Harry Styles appearing at 33 years old and Billie Eilish at 25.

This headline selection represents a significant shift for the event, offering a blend of debut performances and returning stars. Sam Fender opens the Pyramid stage on Friday, Harry Styles performs on Saturday, and Billie Eilish returns to close the event on Sunday night. For Harry Styles, this marks his first time performing at the festival, while Sam Fender returns as a Mercury Prize winner following his 2022 appearance. Billie Eilish, having debuted on the Other stage in 2019, continues her history with the festival as a two-time headliner.

Beyond the Pyramid stage, the festival will host several notable debuts. US pop icon Cher is confirmed for the Sunday afternoon legends slot, which serves as a fourth headline set. Additionally, electro pioneers Kraftwerk will make their debut by headlining the West Holts stage. The line-up also includes performances from Adéla, FKA Twigs, Primal Scream, Kacey Musgraves, and experimental duo Angine de Poitrine. 

Festival organizer Emily Eavis noted that the early musical taster reflects a commitment to the event's return to Worthy Farm. Music on the main stages is scheduled to begin on Friday 25 June, welcoming 200,000 fans to the site. Further lineup announcements are expected from the organizers in the new year.

article.headline: NHS staff caught snooping on patient medical records over 3,000 times
article.summary: Health workers in England accessed sensitive patient information without authorization in 3,029 incidents recorded between 2021 and 2026.
article.body:
Records of a three-year-old boy, victims of the 2024 Southport attack, and victims of the 2023 Nottingham attack were among the files inappropriately accessed by hospital personnel. These instances of unauthorized snooping, documented in a five-year period, reflect a recurring issue where staff inspect information belonging to people they know or satisfy personal curiosity. 

Data breaches of this nature damage the relationship between the health service and the public. Patient advocates emphasize that these actions are distressing for families and fundamentally erode the trust required when individuals provide the NHS with their most sensitive personal information. A reported lack of transparency from some organizations following these discoveries has further compounded the negative impact on patients.

According to the Press Association, 3,029 incidents occurred across England between 2021-22 and 2025-26. This figure is likely an underestimate of the true scale, as only 79 of 143 acute hospital and ambulance trusts provided precise data, while others failed to report exact numbers. The Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO) has identified over 300 reports this year alone regarding staff looking at records without a legitimate reason or sharing information with third parties.

Regulators are now demanding immediate improvements to data security. Paul Arnold, chief executive of the ICO, has written to health leaders across the UK to call for a definitive end to these breaches. Organizations are expected to implement more rigorous access controls, enhance monitoring systems, increase staff training, and ensure consistent disciplinary actions are taken when violations occur. Trusts are also reminded of their legal obligation to report any breaches that pose a risk to patient rights to the ICO within 72 hours.

news.title: عام / تحالف دعم الشرعية في اليمن يُنفذ عملية عسكرية نوعية لاستهداف قدرات الميليشيا الحوثية الإرهابية
news.og_title: عام / تحالف دعم الشرعية في اليمن يُنفذ عملية عسكرية نوعية لاستهداف قدرات الميليشيا الحوثية الإرهابية
news.og_desc:
الرياض 08 جمادى الآخرة 1448 هـ الموافق 18 نوفمبر 2026 م واس
    صرَّح المتحدث الرَّسمي باسم قوات التحالف "تحالف دعم الشرعية في اليمن" اللواء الركن تركي المالكي، بأن التحالف نفذ عملية عسكرية نوعية لاستهداف قدرات الميليشيا الحوثية الإرهابية، حيث تم تدمير 60 هدفًا عسكريًا مشروعًا بمحافظات صنعاء والحديدة وعمران وصعدة.
    وأوضح أن العملية النوعية ركزت على إضعاف القدرات الباليستية والطائرات المسيّرة وتحييد التهديد البحري، كما تم تدمير أنفاق لمخازن جبلية للصواريخ الباليستية وورش تجميع وتخزين المسيّرات.
    // انتهى //

news.title: MWL Condemns Iranian Aggressions Against Bahrain
news.og_title: MWL Condemns Iranian Aggressions Against Bahrain
news.og_desc:
Makkah, November 17, 2026, SPA -- The Muslim World League (MWL) has strongly condemned the repeated Iranian aggressions against the Kingdom of Bahrain.
    In a statement issued by Secretary-General of MWL and Chairman of the Organization of Muslim Scholars Sheikh Dr. Mohammed Al-Issa reiterated his condemnation of what he described as "sinful Iranian acts." He said the actions violate religious values, as well as international and humanitarian laws and norms, pose a grave threat to the security, stability, and well-being of the region's peoples, and undermine efforts to achieve peace.
    Sheikh Al-Issa affirmed the league's full solidarity with Bahrain and its support for all measures the Kingdom takes to safeguard its security, sovereignty, and the safety of its citizens and residents.
    -- SPA
